name: 3D Volume Data Compression
definition: Generalization of 2D compression schemes 1 and 3 to 3D volume data, extracting vectors as shown in Figure 4.
summary: 3D Volume Data Compression is a multiresolution technique that generalizes 2D vector quantization to 3D volumes, extracting spatially correlated vectors from a 3D pyramid to efficiently store and retrieve volumetric datasets.
